english.title: Exceed a temporary 40mph speed restriction on a motorway - automatic camera device
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), subject of a Traffic Order, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAFFIC ORDER..),at a speed exceeding 40 miles per hour, in contravention of a temporary maximum speed restriction
english.legislation: Contrary to the above Traffic Order and section 16(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also H6514 for the manned equipment version of this offence.
(iii) The summons MUST indicate the Order No. and the specific location e.g. (at, by or between marker posts No....) etc, on the special road.
(iv) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence.

6 months
